lead: Vishnu Deo Sai is best known as an Indian politician, born on 21 February 1964 in Chhattisgarh.
As of 2026, he is 62 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and Member of the 13th Lok Sabha.
